Protection
Safeguarding your health grows in importance as you embark on a new phase of life. Saving for your upcoming milestones will be easier when you don’t have to worry about medical expenses.
https://s7ap1.scene7.com/is/image/prudentialholdingsstage/what_you_already_have-4?qlt=85&wid=320&ts=1772445889956&$FullWidth$&dpr=off
What you already have¹
If you are a Singaporean or PR, you’re automatically covered by three national schemes:
MediSave A national savings scheme which helps CPF members save for future medical expenses, especially during retirement.
MediShield Life A health insurance for large hospital bills and selected outpatient treatment costs.
CareShield Life Long-term care insurance scheme for financial support and monthly cash payouts in event of severe disability
https://s7ap1.scene7.com/is/image/prudentialholdingsstage/what_you_already_have-2?qlt=85&wid=320&ts=1772445886117&$FullWidth$&dpr=off
What you may consider²
With big-ticket items lined up in your future, being sufficiently protected is critical in ensuring that your savings can be used as intended – for the new life you’re building.
National schemes do not fully cover:
Hospitalisation An Integrated Shield Plan (IP) provides additional coverage for private hospitals or higher ward classes in public hospitals.
Critical Illness You’ll need coverage of 4x annual income. (Recommended)³
Death & Total and Permanent Disability You’ll need coverage of 9 – 10x annual income. (Recommended)³
Savings² To stay covered and accumulate savings over the years.
Maternity Coverage for baby and mum.
It’s recommended to spend at most 15% of take-home pay on insurance protection.

Wealth
Making plans to settle down requires stability. Having a plan to grow your money steadily will help achieve your goals including future expenses and retiring comfortably with your partner.
https://s7ap1.scene7.com/is/image/prudentialholdingsstage/what_you_should_have-2?qlt=85&wid=320&ts=1772445898949&$FullWidth$&dpr=off
Basics – what you should have³
Emergency Funds At least 3 – 6 months’ worth of expenses (including dependants) for rainy days.
Legacy Planning A plan for a will, family trusts, life insurance, powers of attorney, and CPF nominations.
https://s7ap1.scene7.com/is/image/prudentialholdingsstage/what_you_may_consider-1?qlt=85&wid=320&ts=1772445885622&$FullWidth$&dpr=off
What you may consider²
Creating new memories during your new phase of life will need savings. Giving your money time to grow can mean that your future milestones can be met comfortably.
Investment It is recommended to allocate at least 10%3 of your take-home pay for key milestones.
A Retirement Plan³ It is never too early to start building your nest egg for the retirement lifestyle you want, including monthly payouts.
